mapper.insert: INSERT INTO environment_worker_polls ( organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, environment_uuid, environment_external_id, worker_id, last_poll_at ) SELECT organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, uuid, external_id, #{workerID}, NOW() FROM environments WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{environmentExternalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL ON CONFLICT (environment_uuid, worker_id) DO UPDATE SET last_poll_at = EXCLUDED.last_poll_at
